name: Transactional notifications (email)
description: Adds a single send() entry point for transactional email, so every notification goes through one place that can be tested, logged and rate-limited.

inputs.name: fromAddress
inputs.description: Verified sender address for outgoing mail.

generatedArtifacts.description: send() wrapper and template rendering; the only place that calls the provider SDK.

verification.description: Renders a templated notification and sends it through a test/dry-run transport, asserting the rendered content.

operationalEvidence.evidence: A failed send logs the provider's error code and the notification type — it is never silently swallowed, since a lost notification is otherwise invisible to everyone.
Provider API key and fromAddress are environment variables documented in .env.example; no credential is hardcoded in lib/notify.ts.
